name: phase8_best_random_erasing_0.5.pt
why_this_one: Phase 8 adopted config (resnet18, full fine-tune, patch_crop_size=900, random_erasing_p=0.5) at seed 42. Not the highest single test score ever recorded -- exp 44 hit 0.9694 -- but exp 44's setting was rejected when a paired second seed reversed its sign, so this is the best *confirmed* config.

expected_performance.note: Quote the range, not this run's number. Seed-to-seed spread (~0.048) exceeds most effects measured in this project.

known_weaknesses.Kenya,AA -> Ethiopia,Sidamo: 7/40 test patches misclassified in this direction
known_weaknesses.Brazil,Cerrado -> Brazil,MonteCristo: 7/40 test patches misclassified in this direction
known_weaknesses.note: Those two directional confusions are ~87% of this model's total test error (16/360).
